catalogAudit.name: Boomerang
catalogAudit.proposalDeferred: Thrown-only delivery and recovery are unsupported; do not expose throwing as melee proficiency.

catalogAudit.name: Electro Net
catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Damage comes from the loaded ammunition; Output override: 6 Energy damage per shot.; On hit, the net restrains the target and may deliver a 6 Energy shock.

catalogAudit.name: Electroshock Stun Device
catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Deals no normal HP damage; use as an electroshock incapacitation/control tool.

catalogAudit.name: Energy Chakram
catalogAudit.proposalDeferred: Thrown energy disc needs delivery, recovery and energy rules.

catalogAudit.name: Energy Pistol
catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Damage comes from the loaded ammunition; Output override: 8 Energy damage per shot.

catalogAudit.name: Flintlock Pistol
catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Damage comes from the loaded ammunition; Short-barrel override: 6 Piercing damage with a Musket Ball.

catalogAudit.name: Garrote Wire
catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Deals no automatic HP damage; intended for close-contact restraint and strangulation situations.

catalogAudit.name: Grenade Launcher
catalogAudit.proposalDeferred: Grenade-launcher delivery and area payload mechanics need separate runtime support.

catalogAudit.name: Harpoon
catalogAudit.proposalDeferred: Description explicitly says ranged use; Spears is a melee path. Confirm thrusting versus throwing.

catalogAudit.name: Javelin
catalogAudit.proposalDeferred: Description explicitly says thrown javelin; Spears is a melee path. Confirm intended uses.

catalogAudit.name: Laser Cannon
catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Damage comes from the loaded ammunition; Output override: 30 Energy damage per shot.

catalogAudit.name: Laser Pistol
catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Damage comes from the loaded ammunition; Output override: 8 Energy damage per shot.

catalogAudit.name: Laser Rifle
catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Damage comes from the loaded ammunition; Output override: 12 Energy damage per shot.

catalogAudit.name: Particle Cannon
catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Damage comes from the loaded ammunition; Output override: 20 Energy damage per shot.

catalogAudit.name: Particle Rifle
catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Damage comes from the loaded ammunition; Output override: 18 Energy damage per shot.

catalogAudit.name: Pepper Spray
catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Deals no normal HP damage; use as a short-range chemical incapacitation/control tool.

catalogAudit.name: Plasma Rifle
catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Damage comes from the loaded ammunition; Output override: 16 Energy damage per shot.

catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Damage comes from the loaded ammunition; Output override: 20 Energy damage per shot.

catalogAudit.name: Pulse Rifle
catalogAudit.rulesRequiringReview: Damage comes from the loaded ammunition; Output override: 12 Energy damage per shot.

catalogAudit.name: Rocket Spear

catalogAudit.name: Sling

catalogAudit.name: Slingshot
catalogAudit.proposalDeferred: Slingshot ammunition delivery is unsupported; keep the proposed Slingshots path pending.

catalogAudit.proposalDeferred: Toilet Lid: confirm the intended improvised combat technique.
